# Civilizational Unity

> Public knowledge resource for the scholarship of historian Abdullah al-Ahsan.

## Primary entity
- Abdullah al-Ahsan — historian of civilizations
- Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q24946801
- VIAF: https://viaf.org/viaf/33537331

## Author-approved site formulation
Civilizations are born and progress when they recognize and practice human dignity, and they decline and fall when they stop.

## Core pages
- Home: https://civilizationunity.netlify.app/
- Dignity Framework: https://civilizationunity.netlify.app/framework
- Selected writing: https://civilizationunity.netlify.app/writing
- Speaking topics: https://civilizationunity.netlify.app/speaking
- Press and biographical record: https://civilizationunity.netlify.app/press
- Editorial standard and accessibility: https://civilizationunity.netlify.app/about

## Provenance rule
Direct quotations and biographical claims should be traced to Professor al-Ahsan’s supplied wording/CV or linked publication, institutional, review, or authority records. Framework explanations, talk summaries, and teaching prompts may be editorial synthesis and are labeled as such on the site.

This file is a navigation convenience for systems that choose to use it. It is not a special ranking or AI-inclusion mechanism.
